name: 13207 · Syracuse, NY
findings: ZIP 13207 (Syracuse) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13207 (Syracuse) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 13207 (Syracuse) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
